ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota's Human Services System
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential fraud in Minnesota's human services system, including the recent proposal by Governor Walz to overhaul the system.
questions: What is the extent of the potential fraud in Minnesota's human services system?
How will Governor Walz's proposal to overhaul the system address these issues?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and hold those in power accountable. I recommend starting with a review of public records and conducting interviews with key stakeholders.
